customer.credit_hold: Declared for a hard credit stop. _check_credit_limit reads credit_limit and the AR balance only, so nothing sets this yet; wire it there before exposing it in the UI.
customer.gst_registered: ABN/GST parity field. ABN validation exists (app/core/abn.py) but registration status is not captured on the customer form yet.
supplier.gst_registered: Same as customer.gst_registered — declared for supplier ABN parity, no writer or UI.
inventory.qty_bal: Jim2 movement parity: running balance after the movement. We compute balances by summing instead, so nothing writes it.
inventory.pack_num: Jim2 movement parity: pack/carton reference on a receipt line. No receiving UI captures it.
inventory.bin: Jim2 movement parity: bin the movement touched. Bins live on StockLocation (primary_bin_1/2) rather than per movement.
inventory.link_tran_id: Jim2 movement parity: self-FK linking a movement to the one it reverses. Reversals currently delete the original row instead of linking to it.
inventory.link_gl: Jim2 movement parity: GL account the movement posts to. No GL integration exists.
job.pinned_at: Normalised to `pinnedAt` in frontend/src/api.js and read by nothing. Either build pinning or drop the column and the normalisation together.
purchase_order.bill_no: Supplier bill reference. SupplierBill exists as its own table, so this denormalised copy has no writer.
stock_pricing.price_level_id: False positive worth keeping visible: it is the FK behind the StockPriceLevel.breakpoints relationship, so it is written by appending to that collection rather than by name.
user.sso_provider: Forward declaration for SSO. Login is local password + TOTP; no provider flow exists.
user.sso_subject: Forward declaration for SSO — the subject id from the provider named in sso_provider.
